dimensions.identity: Magenta overlay isolates the assigned Da Costakade 13 block; same block is visible in both game views.
dimensions.family: Source and trial both read as red-brown fired brick. The game wall is a little warmer/brighter than the deeply shaded photo, but family is supported.
dimensions.brightness: Slightly lighter/warmer in the game view; source is strongly shaded, so do not treat this as a calibrated mismatch.
dimensions.texture: Low-contrast brick pattern remains on the vertical wall in front and oblique views. It is now much finer than pass 1 and not obviously oversized at these views; no claim of measured course scale.
dimensions.caps: Top cap is plain grey in the front and oblique views; no brick pattern spill visible.
dimensions.limitations: Material-family review only. Facade detail/geometry and exact texture scale are not validated.

dimensions.identity: Magenta overlay identifies the selected building, but its owner-facing wall is a thin strip in the block view.
dimensions.family: Source supports brown/red-brown brick. The rendered strip is too narrow at this capture scale to confirm that the wall treatment has the same family rather than a neighboring facade color.
dimensions.brightness: Unresolved because the selected wall occupies few pixels and the source upper portion is severely overexposed; do not infer a brightness defect.
dimensions.texture: Course pattern is not legible enough on the selected thin wall in either view to assess scale. No exact scale claim.
dimensions.caps: The selected building has a plain top cap; no clear top-face pattern leak.
dimensions.limitations: Identity is marked, but apparent wall pixels are too thin for confident source-to-render material comparison. Hold pending a closer view.

dimensions.identity: Magenta overlay isolates the assigned Da Costakade 182 facade in the front view; the same volume is visible from the oblique angle.
dimensions.family: Source is warm buff/ochre brick; the trial retains a muted buff/ochre family rather than changing it to red or grey.
dimensions.brightness: Trial reads somewhat duller/browner than the sunlit source photo. Scene lighting and source sun make absolute brightness uncertain; this does not overturn family acceptance.
dimensions.texture: Wall courses are subtle at this zoom and look finer than pass 1; these captures do not establish an exact physical course scale.
dimensions.caps: Top cap appears plain and untextured in both views.
dimensions.limitations: Accepts the broad wall-material family only; no full geometry or exact scale claim.

dimensions.identity: Magenta overlay isolates Da Costakade 40 frontage; target is traceable in the front and oblique views.
dimensions.family: Source and trial both read as grey masonry/brick. The source does not distinguish substrate or finish, and this verdict does not assert either.
dimensions.brightness: Trial is mildly warmer/darker than the grey source impression; cloud/light differences and small wall area make this uncertain.
dimensions.texture: No courses are clearly resolved on this target at either view. Cannot accept or reject exact texture scale from these captures.
dimensions.caps: Visible cap is plain; no clear brick texture on the upward face.
dimensions.limitations: Accepts only the broad grey material family; exact substrate, texture scale, and full geometry are not assessed.

dimensions.identity: Magenta overlay identifies the Elandsgracht 148 wall in both views.
dimensions.family: Source supports a smooth dark blue-grey wall, but `unknown-neutral` did not participate in the material-texture trial.
dimensions.brightness: The existing render is visible but is not a trial treatment, so it cannot validate the material palette brightness.
dimensions.texture: The source is smooth and the existing game wall remains plain; this is not evidence of trial texture behavior.
dimensions.limitations: Explicitly ineligible: unknown-neutral retains original game material. Do not count as acceptance; lettering/graphics are outside this trial.
